debts.description: Implement BSD-FI-001 through BSD-FI-005 in a selected theorem prover with pinned dependencies.
Construct the first genuine individual-curve certificate packet; no exemplar in WP03 is mathematically certified.
Bind any future database experiment to an immutable database release or content-addressed export.
For each future certificate, instantiate only composable WP02 theorem records and reopen every abstract-only source pointer.
